swayable.summary: The video argues that existing laws already protect elections from federal interference, including military and ICE intimidation, and that Trump has never actually succeeded in breaking the electoral system. It delivers this as a direct, spoken address meant to reassure and mobilize people who are worried about election threats.
swayable.title: The Laws Already Protecting Your Vote Right Now
